description: The seller pastes their own listing's title and tags (description and photo count optional); Growtsy runs Etsy's published title and tag rules on that text — the same check as the listing checker's "Paste your listing instead" — and returns one verdict and the first thing to fix. Photo sizes, video, renewal and whether the listing is live need Etsy's data and are listed as not checked. No score, no sales estimate.

description.description: The listing description (optional; used only to see whether it mentions AI)

photos.description: How many photos the listing has (optional)

tags.description: The listing's tags, as an array or a comma-separated string

title.description: The listing title, as on Etsy

name: etsy_listing_text_check
title: Check a pasted Etsy listing
